text:
```yaml
name: Build Plugins

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Build plugins
      run: ./scripts/build-plugins.sh

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: built-plugins
        path: plugins/
```
